items.label: T2
items.content:
Email List Builder conforms to spam regulations by asking each potential name on the list to confirm their email address and OK their addition to the list. They can choose to opt out of the list altogether. 
These tools below will help you manage and use your group's Email list.
Review and Check your list.
            Show Full List
            Show Confirmed Names Only
            Show Unconfirmed Names Only
            Show Names of people who opted not to be on the list
Add, Edit or Delete Records
            Add new Record & send confirmation email
            Add new Record without sending confirmation email
            Delete Existing Record
            Edit Existing Record
Minor Cleanup
            Confirm an unconfirmed Record
            Delete all remaining unconfirmed Records
Communicate with members on your list in a mass emailing
            Send message to confirmed email addresses
            Send message to unconfirrmed email addresses
